meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 macOS 菜单栏加一个闪电图标,绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行、红点表示已停止,并提供启动、停止、重启的控制入口。
howto.when: 在 macOS 上运行 /add-macos-statusbar 时触发。非 macOS 会停下并提示,缺少 swiftc(Xcode 命令行工具)也会停下;若已安装则直接跳到验证。

say.text: 帮我在 macOS 菜单栏加一个 NanoClaw 状态指示器
say.note: 先检查平台和 swiftc,再编译并装成常驻服务

say.text: 菜单栏的红点是什么意思?帮我重启一下 NanoClaw
say.note: 红点表示已停止,重启后状态会刷新

say.text: 我想把菜单栏这个指示器卸载掉
say.note: 按 REMOVE.md 的步骤移除

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent macOS menu bar bolt icon for NanoClaw: green dot when it is running, red dot when stopped, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /add-macos-statusbar on macOS. It stops on other platforms, stops if swiftc is missing, and skips to verification if already installed.

say_en.text: Add a NanoClaw status indicator to my macOS menu bar
say_en.note: Checks the platform and swiftc, then compiles and installs it

say_en.text: The menu bar dot is red - restart NanoClaw for me
say_en.note: Red means stopped; restarting refreshes the status
